messages:
maria: FYI customer Optima flagged totals on their November invoice not matching the dashboard export. dashboard shows 12,345,678 tokens, invoice lines total 12,355,678. they say line items and tiering differ. attaching quick CSV snapshot in thread (csv_export_11-30.csv)
ajay: thx, can you paste account id + invoice id? also did they recently change plans mid-month? :thinking:
maria: acct_78945; inv_2024-11-30-OPT. they migrated from team->business on 2024-11-18 at ~03:15 UTC. dashboard export I generated via /billing export csv for acct_78945 for 2024-11-01..2024-12-01
billing-bot: invoice_generator: invoice inv_2024-11-30-OPT created at 2024-12-01T01:03:12Z by scheduler (run_id=rg-20241201-11)
kevin: quick headstart: ran the usage-agg query against prod raw-events. small diff -- looks like ~10k tokens that were included in invoice but not in dashboard export. possible dupes or late-arrivals around the migration window.
kevin: ```sql
-- prod queries
select sum(tokens) from usage_events
where account_id='acct_78945' and ts >= '2024-11-01' and ts < '2024-12-01';
-- -> 12345678

select sum(tokens) from invoice_line_events
where invoice_id='inv_2024-11-30-OPT';
-- -> 12355678
```
maria: those numbers match what I see. 10,000 token delta. dashboard export generated at 2024-12-01T00:30Z.
sara: finance note: invoice lines are generated by the invoice pipeline which currently uses the canonical invoice-window (00:00..00:59 cutoff) and includes late-arriving usage within a 1h grace for billing. dashboard export is a direct aggregation of usage_events at export time, no grace window. that could explain late-arrival skew, esp during plan migration when requests spiked.
ajay: good call. another potential is retries: we had a retry-bug that duplicated events with new request_ids for a small set of customers during cross-region failover (incidents/2024-11-18-failover). replayed a sample and saw duplicates retained by invoice pipeline but deduped by dashboard export tooling which dedupes on original_request_id.
maria: is there a quick repro we can run to confirm duplicates? customer is pushing for a corrected invoice if it's our error.
ajay: you can run replay-cli with --dedupe=false against their account to see raw events. example: `replay-cli --acct acct_78945 --from 2024-11-18 --to 2024-11-19 --dedupe=false > raw-events.json`
kevin: I ran that and filtered by request_id collisions. found ~11 requests where same client_seq was retried across regions and both copies landed to billing topic. sample snippet:
```json
{"request_id":"r-abc123","client_seq":42,"tokens":900}
{"request_id":"r-abc123-retry","client_seq":42,"tokens":900}
```
sara: if invoice pipeline doesn't dedupe on client_seq or original_request_id, it will double-bill. finance suggests reprocessing the invoice lines for inv_2024-11-30-OPT with a dedupe pass and issuing a credit if reprocess lowers the total.
maria: can eng-billing reprocess and give ETA? customer asked for explanation and possible credit today.
ajay: assigned to eng-billing, I'll run a targeted reprocess with dedupe by client_seq/original_request_id. estimate ~2-3 hours to run + QA. will post results here.
billing-bot: reprocess_job started for inv_2024-11-30-OPT (job_id=reproc-20241201-9)
kevin: logging note: will add a short-term metric to flag accounts with >5 duplicate client_seq events in a day to catch this earlier.
maria: thanks all. I'll update Optima with the plan and expected timeline :thumbsup:
sara: finance will hold off sending the final bill until reprocess completes. will confirm if a credit is needed after eng posts reprocessed totals.
ajay: follow-ups: (1) reproduce locally and confirm dedupe reduces invoice by ~10k tokens, (2) add regression test to pipeline, (3) postmortem if reprocess reveals systemic gap.
maria: sounds good — keep me posted and drop final numbers in this thread.
